fusions.name: Hidden Point
fusions.desc: A hidden spike slides out and deals 28 damage, always as a critical hit, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Palmed Darts
fusions.desc: Throws 3 spines from your palm in a tight spread, each dealing 6 damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Already in Reach
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Edge Kept Sheathed
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 10%.
